segments.he:
העיקר הוא מה שהאדם עובד בעצמו אך צריכים סיוע מלמעלה

"וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה" וְגוֹ'

(כ"ח יב)

עִקַּר כָּל הַתִּקּוּנִים הֵם עַל יְדֵי אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא, כִּי ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ רוֹצֶה שֶׁדַּיְקָא אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ מִזֶּה הָעוֹלָם, וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ לְכַמָּה מֵאֲנָשָׁיו, אִם הָיָה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא רוֹצֶה לַעֲבֹד אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּעַצְמוֹ לֹא הָיָה צָרִיךְ אוֹתְךָ וְכוּ'.

אֲבָל זֶה יָדוּעַ שֶׁקָּשֶׁה וְכָבֵד מְאֹד לְהָאָדָם לַעֲבֹד אֶת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי הַיֵּצֶר הָרַע מִתְגַּבֵּר וּמִתְפַּשֵּׁט מְאֹד, וּבִפְרָט עַל כָּל מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לִכְנֹס בַּעֲבוֹדַת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה עַל פָּסוּק כִּי הִגְדִּיל לַעֲשׂוֹת שֶׁפָּשַׁט יָדוֹ בַּגְּדוֹלִים וְכוּ'. וְעַל כֵּן בְּהֶכְרֵחַ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה סִיּוּעַ מִלְּעֵלָּא.

וּבֶאֱמֶת הַכֹּל מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב מִי הִקְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן צְרִיכִין אֵיזֶה הִתְעוֹרְרוּת מִלְּמַטָּה עַל כָּל פָּנִים, וְזֶה אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהָבִין כְּלָל אֵיךְ הַכֹּל מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן צְרִיכִין אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא, וְזֶהוּ נִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִים וּכְמְבֹאָר מִזֶּה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר.

וְעַל כֵּן יָקָר וְחָשׁוּב מְאֹד אֵצֶל ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ כָּל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת וְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת שֶׁל כָּל אָדָם מִכָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא. וּכְמוּבָא הַרְבֵּה בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בַּגְּמָרָא וּמִדְרָשִׁים שֶׁה' יִתְבָּרַךְ מְבַקֵּשׁ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל פִּתְחוּ לִי כְּמַחַט סדקית וַאֲנִי אֶפְתַּח לָכֶם וְכוּ'. כִּי תֵּכֶף שֶׁהָאָדָם מִתְעוֹרֵר בִּתְפִלָּה וַעֲבוֹדָה בֶּאֱמֶת כָּל שֶׁהוּא, מִתְעוֹרֵר תֵּכֶף אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא הַרְבֵּה, כִּי הַבָּא לִטָּהֵר מְסַיְּעִין אוֹתוֹ. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ לְהִתְעוֹרֵר עוֹד, וּכְמוֹ כֵן נִמְשָׁךְ אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא יוֹתֵר וְכוּ'.

וְזֶה עִקַּר בְּחִינַת הַיִּחוּדִים הַנַּעֲשִׂים מִכָּל הַתְּפִלּוֹת וְהָעֲבוֹדוֹת, שֶׁהוּא מַה שֶׁמִּתְיַחֵד אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא עִם אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא וְכוּ' כַּמּוּבָן בַּכַּוָּנוֹת.

אז השיג יעקב אבינו שבלי אתערותא דלתתא לא מעוררים אותו מן השמים

וְזֶה הִשִּׂיג אָז יַעֲקֹב כְּשֶׁפָּגַע בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא שֶׁהוּא מְקוֹם הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ. וְכַמּוּבָן לְמַשְׂכִּיל בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא עִכְּבוּהוּ כְּשֶׁעָבַר שָׁם, וְהֵשִׁיבוּ, אִיהוּ לֹא יָהִיב דַּעְתֵּיהּ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל וּמִן הַשָּׁמַיִם יְעַכְּבוּהוּ אִיהוּ עַד חָרָן אָזִיל, כַּד מָט לְשָׁם אָמַר וְכוּ'. יְהִיב דַּעְתֵּיהּ לְמֵיהַדַּר, וְקָפְצָה לוֹ הָאָרֶץ וּבָאָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וּפָגַע בַּמָּקוֹם וְכוּ'.

הַיְנוּ כִּי כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה לוֹ אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא לְהִתְעַכֵּב שָׁם, לֹא רָצוּ לְעַכְּבוֹ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם, עַד אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אֶל לִבּוֹ לַחֲזֹר לְשָׁם, וְתֵכֶף נִתְעוֹרֵר אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא לְקָרְבוֹ וַיָּבֹא הַמָּקוֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ. וְאָז רָאָה גֹּדֶל עֹצֶם נִפְלָאוֹת עִנְיַן אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשֶׂה אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא, וְעִקָּרוֹ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה שֶׁשָּׁם כָּל הַיִּחוּדִים כַּיָּדוּעַ. וְאָז הִשִּׂיג בְּעֹצֶם הַשָּׂגָתוֹ שֶׁגַּם כָּל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת וְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת מֵעִמְקֵי עִמְקֵי מְקוֹמוֹת הַנּוֹפְלִים וְהָרְחוֹקִים מְאֹד

גַּם זֶה יָקָר מְאֹד. וְעַל כֵּן תִּקֵּן אָז תְּפִלַּת עַרְבִית שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן זֶה.

וְזֶה וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ. כִּי כְּשֶׁפָּגַע בַּמָּקוֹם שֶׁבָּא לִקְרָאתוֹ מְקוֹם הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ שֶׁהוּא הַבִּנְיָן הַשְּׁלִישִׁי שֶׁיִּתְקַיֵּם וְאָז הִשִּׂיג עֹצֶם מְרִירוּת אֲרִיכַת הַגָּלוּת שֶׁיִּהְיֶה מִקֹּדֶם, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ, שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל חֶשְׁכַת מְרִירַת הַגָּלוּת בְּגוּף וָנֶפֶשׁ כְּמוֹ שֶׁדָּרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה וּמוּבָא בִּדְבָרָיו זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה. וְעַל כֵּן תִּקֵּן אָז תְּפִלַּת עַרְבִית עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהֵבִין אָז עֹצֶם יְקָרַת וַחֲשִׁיבוּת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא אֲפִלּוּ מֵעִמְקֵי עִמְקֵי הַחֹשֶׁךְ אֲפֵלָה וְכוּ' כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל.

וְאָז וַיִּקַּח מֵאַבְנֵי הַמָּקוֹם וַיָּשֶׂם מְרַאֲשׁוֹתָיו, בְּחִינַת הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת וְהַנְּפָשׁוֹת הַנּוֹפְלִין שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי קֹדֶשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל חוּצוֹת, וַיָּשֶׂם מְרַאֲשׁוֹתָיו שֶׁהֶעֱלָם וְקִשְּׁרָם בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה. כִּי כֻּלָּא בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה אִתְבָּרִירוּ. וְאָז וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא שֶׁהוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ לְכָל הַמְּקוֹמוֹת הַנְּמוּכִים הַנִּזְכָּרִים לְעֵיל, לְבָרֵר וּלְהַעֲלוֹת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת מִשָּׁם.

וְאָז וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה. שֶׁהָאָדָם צָרִיךְ לָצֵאת מִדַּרְגָּא לְדַרְגָּא כְּמוֹ בְּסֻלָּם. וְהַכֹּל בִּשְׁבִיל תִּקּוּן הָעוֹלָמוֹת עַל יְדֵי אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא דַּיְקָא. וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ. מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים בְּחִינַת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא. מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים יוֹרְדִים בְּחִינַת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא שֶׁיּוֹרֵד מִלְּמַעְלָה לְסַיֵּעַ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמִּקֹּדֶם עָלָה מִלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא.

כִּי עַל יְדֵי כָּל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת וְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה מִלְּמַטָּה נִבְרָאִים מַלְאָכִים שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים מִלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה. וּבְאִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא אִתְעַר לְעֵלָּא, וְאָז נִמְשָׁךְ סִיּוּעַ מִלְּעֵלָּא שֶׁהוּא מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים הַיּוֹרְדִים מִלְּמַעְלָה לְמַטָּה לְסַיְּעוֹ. וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ. וְעַל יְדֵי שֶׁנִּכְלָלִין אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא עִם אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא, עַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשִׂים כָּל הַיִּחוּדִים וְהַתִּקּוּנִים כַּיָּדוּעַ.

וְאָז וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ ה' בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי. כִּי אֲפִלּוּ יַעֲקֹב בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ הָעֲצוּמָה נֶעֱלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא יָדַע מִתְּחִלָּה עֹצֶם קְדֻשַּׁת הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא עַד שֶׁנִּתְעוֹרֵר מֵעַצְמוֹ לַחֲזֹר לְכָאן כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. וְאָז בָּא הַמָּקוֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ וְלָן שָׁם, וְאָז הִשִּׂיג עֹצֶם קְדֻשַּׁת הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה שֶׁבּוֹ תָּלוּי תִּקּוּן כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הַנּוֹפְלִין וְכָל הָעוֹלָמוֹת.

וּבָזֶה תִּקֵּן לְהַכְנִיס בְּלֵב כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת לְדוֹרוֹת עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הַנּוֹפְלִין מְאֹד שֶׁסּוֹבְרִין שֶׁבִּמְקוֹמָם אֵין נִמְצָא ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ, יֵדְעוּ וְיַאֲמִינוּ שֶׁגַּם בִּמְקוֹמָם יֵשׁ ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי מְלֹא כָּל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ רַק שֶׁנֶּעְלַם מֵהֶם. וְשֶׁגַּם הַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת שֶׁלָּהֶם יָקָר מְאֹד וְשֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לִמְצֹא ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת יֵשׁ ה' בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה רַק שֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ מִגֹּדֶל הַהַעֲלָמָה בְּחִינַת וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי.

אֲבָל אִם יִתְעוֹרֵר בְּחִינַת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא יִזְכֶּה לְמָצְאוֹ כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. וְאָז וַיִּירָא וַיֹּאמַר מַה נּוֹרָא הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה, שֶׁהִשִּׂיג עֹצֶם נוֹרָאוֹת הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה שֶׁשָּׁם שָׁרְשֵׁי כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת, וּמִשָּׁם נִמְשָׁךְ הַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת לִתְשׁוּבָה לְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל. אַךְ אַף עַל פִּי כֵן צְרִיכִין הִתְעוֹרְרוּת מִלְּמַטָּה כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל.

וְאָז אָמַר אֵין זֶה כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹקִים שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל הַבֵּית הַשְּׁלִישִׁי שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בִּזְכוּתוֹ, שֶׁרַק זֶה נִקְרָא בַּיִת לֹא כְּאַבְרָהָם שֶׁקְּרָאוֹ הַר וְכוּ' כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, אֲבָל אָמַר בִּלְשׁוֹן אֵין זֶה שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל הַחֻרְבָּן שֶׁל שְׁנֵי בָּתִּים הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהַשֵּׁנִי כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. לְהוֹדִיעַ שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי עִקַּר הַתִּקּוּן עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת בַּיִת הַשְּׁלִישִׁי, אֲבָל עֲדַיִן אֵין זֶה, כִּי עֲדַיִן לֹא בָּאנוּ לְתִקּוּנוֹ, כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹקִים, כִּי עֲדַיִן צְרִיכִים תִּקּוּנִים הַרְבֵּה עַד שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה לִבְחִינַת בֵּית אֱלֹקִים. וּבָזֶה רִמֵּז שֶׁצְּרִיכִין מִקֹּדֶם בָּתֵּי כְּנֵסִיּוֹת וּבָתֵּי מִדְרָשׁוֹת הַרְבֵּה שֶׁהֵם מִקְדָּשׁ מְעַט שֶׁשָּׁם מִתְקַבְּצִין כָּל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת שֶׁלְּמַטָּה וְכוּ' כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הַרְבֵּה יִזְכּוּ לִתְשׁוּבָה כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. עַד שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית אֱלֹקִים זֶה, וְאָז יָשׁוּבוּ הַכֹּל אֶל ה' וְיִתְתַּקֵּן הַכֹּל בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ אָמֵן.

(הלכות תפלת המנחה הלכה ז' אות פ"ד)
segments.en:
The essential thing is what a person does in serving on his own, but assistance from above is needed.

"And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set upon the earth," etc.

(28:12)

The essential part of all the rectifications is through an awakening from below, for Hashem, blessed be He, wants specifically us to serve Him from this world. And as our master, teacher, and Rebbe said to several of his followers: If the Holy One, blessed be He, wanted to serve Himself by Himself, He would not need you, etc.

But it is known that it is very difficult and burdensome for a person to serve Hashem, blessed be He, because the evil inclination grows exceedingly strong and spreads, and particularly against anyone who wants to enter the service of Hashem, blessed be He. As our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said concerning the verse, "For he has done great things": that he stretched out his hand against the great, etc. And therefore there must necessarily be assistance from above.

And in truth, everything is from Him, blessed be He, as it is written, "Who has preceded Me, that I should repay?" And nevertheless, some awakening from below is needed, at least. And this is utterly impossible to understand: how everything is from Him, blessed be He, and nevertheless an awakening from below is needed. And this is among the wonders of the One perfect in knowledge, and as is explained concerning this elsewhere.

And therefore every single awakening of every person, from whatever place he is, is very precious and important to Hashem, blessed be He. And as is cited extensively in the words of our Rabbis, of blessed memory, in the Gemara and Midrashim: Hashem, blessed be He, asks of Israel, "Open for Me an opening like the eye of a fine needle, and I will open for you," etc. For immediately when a person awakens in prayer and service in truth, however little, an abundant awakening from above is immediately aroused, for one who comes to purify himself is assisted. And through this he has strength to awaken further, and correspondingly a still greater awakening from above is drawn forth, etc.

And this is the essential aspect of the unifications effected by all the prayers and services: the uniting of the awakening from below with the awakening from above, etc., as understood in the mystical intentions.

Then Yaakov our patriarch apprehended that without an awakening from below, they do not awaken him from Heaven.

And Yaakov apprehended this then, when he encountered that place, which is the site of the Holy Temple. And as can be understood by a discerning person from the words of our Rabbis, of blessed memory, who said: And why did they not detain him when he passed there? And they answered: He himself did not set his mind to pray, and should they detain him from Heaven? He went as far as Charan. When he arrived there, he said, etc. He set his mind to return, and the earth contracted for him, and it came to meet him, "And he encountered the place," etc.

That is, as long as he had no awakening from below to stay there, they did not wish to detain him from Heaven, until he took it to heart to return there; and immediately an awakening from above was aroused to draw him near, and the place came to meet him. And then he saw the great immensity of the wonders of the matter of awakening from below, through which an awakening from above is effected, and its principal locus is in this place, where all the unifications are, as is known. And then, through his immense apprehension, he apprehended that even every single awakening from the deepest depths of the places of those who have fallen and are very far away

This too is very precious. And therefore he then instituted the evening prayer, which is an aspect of this rectification.

And this is: "And he encountered the place and lodged there, for the sun had set." For when he encountered the place that came to meet him, the site of the Holy Temple—which is the third building that will endure—he then apprehended the immense bitterness of the prolonged exile that would precede it. This is the aspect of "and he lodged there, for the sun had set," which alludes to the darkness of the bitterness of exile in body and soul, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded, and as is cited in his words, of blessed memory. And therefore he then instituted the evening prayer, through understanding then the immense preciousness and importance of an awakening from below, even from the deepest depths of pitch darkness, etc., as mentioned above.

And then, "And he took some of the stones of the place and put them at his head": the aspect of the fallen sparks and souls, which are the aspect of "The holy stones are poured out at the head of every street." "And he put them at his head": he elevated them and bound them in his holy thought, for all is clarified through thought. And then, "And he lay down in that place": he lowered himself to all the low places mentioned above, to clarify and elevate the souls from there.

And then, "And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set upon the earth, and its head reached heavenward." For a person must go out from level to level, as on a ladder. And all is for the rectification of the worlds, specifically through awakening from below. "And behold, angels of Elokim were ascending and descending upon it." "Angels of Elokim ascending": the aspect of awakening from below. "Angels of Elokim descending": the aspect of awakening from above, which descends from above to assist, through the awakening from below having first ascended from below to above.

For through every single holy awakening from below, angels are created; this is the aspect of angels of Elokim ascending from below to above. And through an awakening from below, an awakening above is aroused; and then assistance is drawn forth from above, which is the angels of Elokim descending from above to below to assist him. And this is the aspect of "And behold, angels of Elokim were ascending and descending upon it." And through the inclusion of the awakening from below with the awakening from above, through this all the unifications and rectifications are effected, as is known.

And then, "And Yaakov awoke from his sleep and said, Indeed, Hashem is in this place, and I did not know." For even from Yaakov, in his immense holiness, it was hidden; and at first he did not know the immense holiness of that place, until he awakened on his own to return here, as mentioned above. And then the place came to meet him, and he lodged there; and then he apprehended the immense holiness of this place, on which the rectification of all the fallen souls and all the worlds depends.

And through this he effected a rectification, instilling in the hearts of all the souls throughout the generations until this day that even the souls who have fallen very far, who think that Hashem, blessed be He, is not to be found in their place, should know and believe that even in their place Hashem, blessed be He, is present, for the whole earth is filled with His glory; it is only hidden from them. And [they should know and believe] that their awakening too is very precious, and that they can find Hashem, blessed be He, in every place in the world, for in truth Hashem is in this place; it is only that one does not know, because of the great concealment—the aspect of "And I did not know."

But if he awakens in the aspect of awakening from below, he will merit to find Him, as mentioned above. And then, "And he feared and said, How awesome is this place": he apprehended the immense awesomeness of this place, where the roots of all the souls are, and from there the awakening to repentance is drawn forth for all Israel. But nevertheless an awakening from below is needed, as mentioned above.

And then he said, "This is none other than the house of Elokim," which alludes to the third Temple, which will be built in his merit; only this is called a house, not like Avraham, who called it a mountain, etc., as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. But he used the expression "This is not," which alludes to the destruction of the two Temples, the first and the second, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. [This is] to make known that certainly the essential rectification is through the aspect of the third Temple, but "This is not" yet, for we have not yet attained its rectification—"other than the house of Elokim"—for many rectifications are still needed until we merit the aspect of the house of Elokim. And through this he alluded that first many synagogues and study halls are needed, which are a little sanctuary, where all the awakening from below is gathered, etc., as mentioned above. Through this many will merit repentance, as mentioned above, until this house of Elokim is built; and then everyone will return to Hashem, and everything will be rectified, speedily in our days, Amen.

(Halachos of Tefillas HaMinchuh [Afternoon Prayer], Halacha 7, item 84)

pairs.he: העיקר הוא מה שהאדם עובד בעצמו אך צריכים סיוע מלמעלה
pairs.en: The essential thing is what a person does in serving on his own, but assistance from above is needed.

pairs.he: "וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה" וְגוֹ'
pairs.en: "And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set upon the earth," etc.

pairs.he: (כ"ח יב)

עִקַּר כָּל הַתִּקּוּנִים הֵם עַל יְדֵי אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא, כִּי ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ רוֹצֶה שֶׁדַּיְקָא אֲנַחְנוּ נַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ מִזֶּה הָעוֹלָם, וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר אֲדוֹנֵנוּ מוֹרֵנוּ וְרַבֵּנוּ לְכַמָּה מֵאֲנָשָׁיו, אִם הָיָה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא רוֹצֶה לַעֲבֹד אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּעַצְמוֹ לֹא הָיָה צָרִיךְ אוֹתְךָ וְכוּ'.
pairs.en: The essential part of all the rectifications is through an awakening from below, for Hashem, blessed be He, wants specifically us to serve Him from this world. And as our master, teacher, and Rebbe said to several of his followers: If the Holy One, blessed be He, wanted to serve Himself by Himself, He would not need you, etc.

pairs.he: אֲבָל זֶה יָדוּעַ שֶׁקָּשֶׁה וְכָבֵד מְאֹד לְהָאָדָם לַעֲבֹד אֶת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי הַיֵּצֶר הָרַע מִתְגַּבֵּר וּמִתְפַּשֵּׁט מְאֹד, וּבִפְרָט עַל כָּל מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לִכְנֹס בַּעֲבוֹדַת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה עַל פָּסוּק כִּי הִגְדִּיל לַעֲשׂוֹת שֶׁפָּשַׁט יָדוֹ בַּגְּדוֹלִים וְכוּ'. וְעַל כֵּן בְּהֶכְרֵחַ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה סִיּוּעַ מִלְּעֵלָּא.
pairs.en: But it is known that it is very difficult and burdensome for a person to serve Hashem, blessed be He, because the evil inclination grows exceedingly strong and spreads, and particularly against anyone who wants to enter the service of Hashem, blessed be He. As our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said concerning the verse, "For he has done great things": that he stretched out his hand against the great, etc. And therefore there must necessarily be assistance from above.

pairs.he: וּבֶאֱמֶת הַכֹּל מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב מִי הִקְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּם, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן צְרִיכִין אֵיזֶה הִתְעוֹרְרוּת מִלְּמַטָּה עַל כָּל פָּנִים, וְזֶה אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהָבִין כְּלָל אֵיךְ הַכֹּל מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן צְרִיכִין אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא, וְזֶהוּ נִפְלְאוֹת תְּמִים דֵּעִים וּכְמְבֹאָר מִזֶּה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר.
pairs.en: And in truth, everything is from Him, blessed be He, as it is written, "Who has preceded Me, that I should repay?" And nevertheless, some awakening from below is needed, at least. And this is utterly impossible to understand: how everything is from Him, blessed be He, and nevertheless an awakening from below is needed. And this is among the wonders of the One perfect in knowledge, and as is explained concerning this elsewhere.

pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן יָקָר וְחָשׁוּב מְאֹד אֵצֶל ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ כָּל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת וְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת שֶׁל כָּל אָדָם מִכָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא. וּכְמוּבָא הַרְבֵּה בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בַּגְּמָרָא וּמִדְרָשִׁים שֶׁה' יִתְבָּרַךְ מְבַקֵּשׁ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל פִּתְחוּ לִי כְּמַחַט סדקית וַאֲנִי אֶפְתַּח לָכֶם וְכוּ'. כִּי תֵּכֶף שֶׁהָאָדָם מִתְעוֹרֵר בִּתְפִלָּה וַעֲבוֹדָה בֶּאֱמֶת כָּל שֶׁהוּא, מִתְעוֹרֵר תֵּכֶף אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא הַרְבֵּה, כִּי הַבָּא לִטָּהֵר מְסַיְּעִין אוֹתוֹ. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ לְהִתְעוֹרֵר עוֹד, וּכְמוֹ כֵן נִמְשָׁךְ אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא יוֹתֵר וְכוּ'.
pairs.en: And therefore every single awakening of every person, from whatever place he is, is very precious and important to Hashem, blessed be He. And as is cited extensively in the words of our Rabbis, of blessed memory, in the Gemara and Midrashim: Hashem, blessed be He, asks of Israel, "Open for Me an opening like the eye of a fine needle, and I will open for you," etc. For immediately when a person awakens in prayer and service in truth, however little, an abundant awakening from above is immediately aroused, for one who comes to purify himself is assisted. And through this he has strength to awaken further, and correspondingly a still greater awakening from above is drawn forth, etc.

pairs.he: וְזֶה עִקַּר בְּחִינַת הַיִּחוּדִים הַנַּעֲשִׂים מִכָּל הַתְּפִלּוֹת וְהָעֲבוֹדוֹת, שֶׁהוּא מַה שֶׁמִּתְיַחֵד אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא עִם אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא וְכוּ' כַּמּוּבָן בַּכַּוָּנוֹת.
pairs.en: And this is the essential aspect of the unifications effected by all the prayers and services: the uniting of the awakening from below with the awakening from above, etc., as understood in the mystical intentions.

pairs.he: אז השיג יעקב אבינו שבלי אתערותא דלתתא לא מעוררים אותו מן השמים
pairs.en: Then Yaakov our patriarch apprehended that without an awakening from below, they do not awaken him from Heaven.

pairs.he: וְזֶה הִשִּׂיג אָז יַעֲקֹב כְּשֶׁפָּגַע בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא שֶׁהוּא מְקוֹם הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ. וְכַמּוּבָן לְמַשְׂכִּיל בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה שֶׁאָמְרוּ וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא עִכְּבוּהוּ כְּשֶׁעָבַר שָׁם, וְהֵשִׁיבוּ, אִיהוּ לֹא יָהִיב דַּעְתֵּיהּ לְהִתְפַּלֵּל וּמִן הַשָּׁמַיִם יְעַכְּבוּהוּ אִיהוּ עַד חָרָן אָזִיל, כַּד מָט לְשָׁם אָמַר וְכוּ'. יְהִיב דַּעְתֵּיהּ לְמֵיהַדַּר, וְקָפְצָה לוֹ הָאָרֶץ וּבָאָה לִקְרָאתוֹ וּפָגַע בַּמָּקוֹם וְכוּ'.
pairs.en: And Yaakov apprehended this then, when he encountered that place, which is the site of the Holy Temple. And as can be understood by a discerning person from the words of our Rabbis, of blessed memory, who said: And why did they not detain him when he passed there? And they answered: He himself did not set his mind to pray, and should they detain him from Heaven? He went as far as Charan. When he arrived there, he said, etc. He set his mind to return, and the earth contracted for him, and it came to meet him, "And he encountered the place," etc.

pairs.he: הַיְנוּ כִּי כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה לוֹ אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא לְהִתְעַכֵּב שָׁם, לֹא רָצוּ לְעַכְּבוֹ מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם, עַד אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אֶל לִבּוֹ לַחֲזֹר לְשָׁם, וְתֵכֶף נִתְעוֹרֵר אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא לְקָרְבוֹ וַיָּבֹא הַמָּקוֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ. וְאָז רָאָה גֹּדֶל עֹצֶם נִפְלָאוֹת עִנְיַן אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשֶׂה אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא, וְעִקָּרוֹ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה שֶׁשָּׁם כָּל הַיִּחוּדִים כַּיָּדוּעַ. וְאָז הִשִּׂיג בְּעֹצֶם הַשָּׂגָתוֹ שֶׁגַּם כָּל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת וְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת מֵעִמְקֵי עִמְקֵי מְקוֹמוֹת הַנּוֹפְלִים וְהָרְחוֹקִים מְאֹד
pairs.en: That is, as long as he had no awakening from below to stay there, they did not wish to detain him from Heaven, until he took it to heart to return there; and immediately an awakening from above was aroused to draw him near, and the place came to meet him. And then he saw the great immensity of the wonders of the matter of awakening from below, through which an awakening from above is effected, and its principal locus is in this place, where all the unifications are, as is known. And then, through his immense apprehension, he apprehended that even every single awakening from the deepest depths of the places of those who have fallen and are very far away

pairs.he: גַּם זֶה יָקָר מְאֹד. וְעַל כֵּן תִּקֵּן אָז תְּפִלַּת עַרְבִית שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן זֶה.
pairs.en: This too is very precious. And therefore he then instituted the evening prayer, which is an aspect of this rectification.

pairs.he: וְזֶה וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ. כִּי כְּשֶׁפָּגַע בַּמָּקוֹם שֶׁבָּא לִקְרָאתוֹ מְקוֹם הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ שֶׁהוּא הַבִּנְיָן הַשְּׁלִישִׁי שֶׁיִּתְקַיֵּם וְאָז הִשִּׂיג עֹצֶם מְרִירוּת אֲרִיכַת הַגָּלוּת שֶׁיִּהְיֶה מִקֹּדֶם, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ, שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל חֶשְׁכַת מְרִירַת הַגָּלוּת בְּגוּף וָנֶפֶשׁ כְּמוֹ שֶׁדָּרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה וּמוּבָא בִּדְבָרָיו זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה. וְעַל כֵּן תִּקֵּן אָז תְּפִלַּת עַרְבִית עַל יְדֵי שֶׁהֵבִין אָז עֹצֶם יְקָרַת וַחֲשִׁיבוּת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא אֲפִלּוּ מֵעִמְקֵי עִמְקֵי הַחֹשֶׁךְ אֲפֵלָה וְכוּ' כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל.
pairs.en: And this is: "And he encountered the place and lodged there, for the sun had set." For when he encountered the place that came to meet him, the site of the Holy Temple—which is the third building that will endure—he then apprehended the immense bitterness of the prolonged exile that would precede it. This is the aspect of "and he lodged there, for the sun had set," which alludes to the darkness of the bitterness of exile in body and soul, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded, and as is cited in his words, of blessed memory. And therefore he then instituted the evening prayer, through understanding then the immense preciousness and importance of an awakening from below, even from the deepest depths of pitch darkness, etc., as mentioned above.

pairs.he: וְאָז וַיִּקַּח מֵאַבְנֵי הַמָּקוֹם וַיָּשֶׂם מְרַאֲשׁוֹתָיו, בְּחִינַת הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת וְהַנְּפָשׁוֹת הַנּוֹפְלִין שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי קֹדֶשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל חוּצוֹת, וַיָּשֶׂם מְרַאֲשׁוֹתָיו שֶׁהֶעֱלָם וְקִשְּׁרָם בְּמַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה. כִּי כֻּלָּא בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה אִתְבָּרִירוּ. וְאָז וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא שֶׁהוֹרִיד אֶת עַצְמוֹ לְכָל הַמְּקוֹמוֹת הַנְּמוּכִים הַנִּזְכָּרִים לְעֵיל, לְבָרֵר וּלְהַעֲלוֹת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת מִשָּׁם.
pairs.en: And then, "And he took some of the stones of the place and put them at his head": the aspect of the fallen sparks and souls, which are the aspect of "The holy stones are poured out at the head of every street." "And he put them at his head": he elevated them and bound them in his holy thought, for all is clarified through thought. And then, "And he lay down in that place": he lowered himself to all the low places mentioned above, to clarify and elevate the souls from there.

pairs.he: וְאָז וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה. שֶׁהָאָדָם צָרִיךְ לָצֵאת מִדַּרְגָּא לְדַרְגָּא כְּמוֹ בְּסֻלָּם. וְהַכֹּל בִּשְׁבִיל תִּקּוּן הָעוֹלָמוֹת עַל יְדֵי אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא דַּיְקָא. וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ. מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים בְּחִינַת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא. מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים יוֹרְדִים בְּחִינַת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא שֶׁיּוֹרֵד מִלְּמַעְלָה לְסַיֵּעַ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמִּקֹּדֶם עָלָה מִלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא.
pairs.en: And then, "And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set upon the earth, and its head reached heavenward." For a person must go out from level to level, as on a ladder. And all is for the rectification of the worlds, specifically through awakening from below. "And behold, angels of Elokim were ascending and descending upon it." "Angels of Elokim ascending": the aspect of awakening from below. "Angels of Elokim descending": the aspect of awakening from above, which descends from above to assist, through the awakening from below having first ascended from below to above.

pairs.he: כִּי עַל יְדֵי כָּל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת וְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה מִלְּמַטָּה נִבְרָאִים מַלְאָכִים שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים מִלְּמַטָּה לְמַעְלָה. וּבְאִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא אִתְעַר לְעֵלָּא, וְאָז נִמְשָׁךְ סִיּוּעַ מִלְּעֵלָּא שֶׁהוּא מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים הַיּוֹרְדִים מִלְּמַעְלָה לְמַטָּה לְסַיְּעוֹ. וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ. וְעַל יְדֵי שֶׁנִּכְלָלִין אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא עִם אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְעֵלָּא, עַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשִׂים כָּל הַיִּחוּדִים וְהַתִּקּוּנִים כַּיָּדוּעַ.
pairs.en: For through every single holy awakening from below, angels are created; this is the aspect of angels of Elokim ascending from below to above. And through an awakening from below, an awakening above is aroused; and then assistance is drawn forth from above, which is the angels of Elokim descending from above to below to assist him. And this is the aspect of "And behold, angels of Elokim were ascending and descending upon it." And through the inclusion of the awakening from below with the awakening from above, through this all the unifications and rectifications are effected, as is known.

pairs.he: וְאָז וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ ה' בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי. כִּי אֲפִלּוּ יַעֲקֹב בִּקְדֻשָּׁתוֹ הָעֲצוּמָה נֶעֱלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְלֹא יָדַע מִתְּחִלָּה עֹצֶם קְדֻשַּׁת הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא עַד שֶׁנִּתְעוֹרֵר מֵעַצְמוֹ לַחֲזֹר לְכָאן כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. וְאָז בָּא הַמָּקוֹם לִקְרָאתוֹ וְלָן שָׁם, וְאָז הִשִּׂיג עֹצֶם קְדֻשַּׁת הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה שֶׁבּוֹ תָּלוּי תִּקּוּן כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הַנּוֹפְלִין וְכָל הָעוֹלָמוֹת.
pairs.en: And then, "And Yaakov awoke from his sleep and said, Indeed, Hashem is in this place, and I did not know." For even from Yaakov, in his immense holiness, it was hidden; and at first he did not know the immense holiness of that place, until he awakened on his own to return here, as mentioned above. And then the place came to meet him, and he lodged there; and then he apprehended the immense holiness of this place, on which the rectification of all the fallen souls and all the worlds depends.

pairs.he: וּבָזֶה תִּקֵּן לְהַכְנִיס בְּלֵב כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת לְדוֹרוֹת עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה, שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הַנּוֹפְלִין מְאֹד שֶׁסּוֹבְרִין שֶׁבִּמְקוֹמָם אֵין נִמְצָא ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ, יֵדְעוּ וְיַאֲמִינוּ שֶׁגַּם בִּמְקוֹמָם יֵשׁ ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי מְלֹא כָּל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ רַק שֶׁנֶּעְלַם מֵהֶם. וְשֶׁגַּם הַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת שֶׁלָּהֶם יָקָר מְאֹד וְשֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לִמְצֹא ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת יֵשׁ ה' בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה רַק שֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ מִגֹּדֶל הַהַעֲלָמָה בְּחִינַת וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי.
pairs.en: And through this he effected a rectification, instilling in the hearts of all the souls throughout the generations until this day that even the souls who have fallen very far, who think that Hashem, blessed be He, is not to be found in their place, should know and believe that even in their place Hashem, blessed be He, is present, for the whole earth is filled with His glory; it is only hidden from them. And [they should know and believe] that their awakening too is very precious, and that they can find Hashem, blessed be He, in every place in the world, for in truth Hashem is in this place; it is only that one does not know, because of the great concealment—the aspect of "And I did not know."

pairs.he: אֲבָל אִם יִתְעוֹרֵר בְּחִינַת אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא יִזְכֶּה לְמָצְאוֹ כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. וְאָז וַיִּירָא וַיֹּאמַר מַה נּוֹרָא הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה, שֶׁהִשִּׂיג עֹצֶם נוֹרָאוֹת הַמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה שֶׁשָּׁם שָׁרְשֵׁי כָּל הַנְּפָשׁוֹת, וּמִשָּׁם נִמְשָׁךְ הַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת לִתְשׁוּבָה לְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵל. אַךְ אַף עַל פִּי כֵן צְרִיכִין הִתְעוֹרְרוּת מִלְּמַטָּה כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל.
pairs.en: But if he awakens in the aspect of awakening from below, he will merit to find Him, as mentioned above. And then, "And he feared and said, How awesome is this place": he apprehended the immense awesomeness of this place, where the roots of all the souls are, and from there the awakening to repentance is drawn forth for all Israel. But nevertheless an awakening from below is needed, as mentioned above.

pairs.he: וְאָז אָמַר אֵין זֶה כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹקִים שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל הַבֵּית הַשְּׁלִישִׁי שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בִּזְכוּתוֹ, שֶׁרַק זֶה נִקְרָא בַּיִת לֹא כְּאַבְרָהָם שֶׁקְּרָאוֹ הַר וְכוּ' כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, אֲבָל אָמַר בִּלְשׁוֹן אֵין זֶה שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל הַחֻרְבָּן שֶׁל שְׁנֵי בָּתִּים הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהַשֵּׁנִי כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. לְהוֹדִיעַ שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי עִקַּר הַתִּקּוּן עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת בַּיִת הַשְּׁלִישִׁי, אֲבָל עֲדַיִן אֵין זֶה, כִּי עֲדַיִן לֹא בָּאנוּ לְתִקּוּנוֹ, כִּי אִם בֵּית אֱלֹקִים, כִּי עֲדַיִן צְרִיכִים תִּקּוּנִים הַרְבֵּה עַד שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה לִבְחִינַת בֵּית אֱלֹקִים. וּבָזֶה רִמֵּז שֶׁצְּרִיכִין מִקֹּדֶם בָּתֵּי כְּנֵסִיּוֹת וּבָתֵּי מִדְרָשׁוֹת הַרְבֵּה שֶׁהֵם מִקְדָּשׁ מְעַט שֶׁשָּׁם מִתְקַבְּצִין כָּל הִתְעוֹרְרוּת שֶׁלְּמַטָּה וְכוּ' כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הַרְבֵּה יִזְכּוּ לִתְשׁוּבָה כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. עַד שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית אֱלֹקִים זֶה, וְאָז יָשׁוּבוּ הַכֹּל אֶל ה' וְיִתְתַּקֵּן הַכֹּל בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ אָמֵן.
pairs.en: And then he said, "This is none other than the house of Elokim," which alludes to the third Temple, which will be built in his merit; only this is called a house, not like Avraham, who called it a mountain, etc., as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. But he used the expression "This is not," which alludes to the destruction of the two Temples, the first and the second, as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said. [This is] to make known that certainly the essential rectification is through the aspect of the third Temple, but "This is not" yet, for we have not yet attained its rectification—"other than the house of Elokim"—for many rectifications are still needed until we merit the aspect of the house of Elokim. And through this he alluded that first many synagogues and study halls are needed, which are a little sanctuary, where all the awakening from below is gathered, etc., as mentioned above. Through this many will merit repentance, as mentioned above, until this house of Elokim is built; and then everyone will return to Hashem, and everything will be rectified, speedily in our days, Amen.

pairs.en: (Halachos of Tefillas HaMinchuh [Afternoon Prayer], Halacha 7, item 84)

segments.he:
הודיעו ליעקב בחלום כי על האדם לעבור עליות וירידות ואל יחשוב בשעת העליה כי תמיד ישאר כך

"וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה" וְגוֹ'

(כ"ח, יב)

צְרִיכִים לֵידַע שֶׁלִּפְעָמִים כְּשֶׁה' יִתְבָּרַךְ עוֹזֵר לוֹ שֶׁמִּתְנוֹצֵץ לוֹ אֵיזֶה הִתְנוֹצְצוּת וְרוֹאֶה אֵיזֶה הִתְקָרְבוּת אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת הוּא הִתְקָרְבוּת אֲמִתִּי מֵאִתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְהוּא חֶסֶד גָּדוֹל וְנִפְלָא שֶׁה' יִתְבָּרַךְ מַפְלִיא חַסְדּוֹ עִמּוֹ. אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אַל יִטְעֶה שֶׁכְּבָר הוּא סָמוּךְ וְקָרוֹב לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ וּלְהַתּוֹרָה וּלְהַצַּדִּיקִים.

כִּי צָרִיךְ לֵידַע כָּל הַנַּ"ל שֶׁכָּל מַה שֶׁהוּא מְקֹרָב בְּיוֹתֵר, עֲדַיִן הוּא רָחוֹק מְאֹד מְאֹד, כִּי לִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהַסְבִּיר זֹאת הֵיטֵב כַּמְבֹאָר בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַנַּ"ל. אֲבָל אַף עַל פִּי כֵן צָרִיךְ לֵידַע שֶׁהַיְשׁוּעָה וְהַחֶסֶד שֶׁל כָּל הַהִתְקָרְבוּת וְהַהִתְקָרְבוּת כָּל שֶׁהוּא הוּא חֶסֶד נִפְלָא כִּי הוּא הִתְקָרְבוּת אֲמִתִּי וִישׁוּעָתוֹ לָנֶצַח. אַךְ אַף עַל פִּי כֵן עֲדַיִן רָחוֹק מִמֶּנּוּ מְאֹד תַּכְלִית יְשׁוּעָתוֹ וְצָרִיךְ עֲדַיִן לִהְיוֹת עוֹמֵד וּמְצַפֶּה הַרְבֵּה לִישׁוּעָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ עַד שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לְהִוָּשַׁע בִּשְׁלֵמוּת לָצֵאת מִמַּה שֶׁהוּא צָרִיךְ לָצֵאת וּלְהִתְקָרֵב לְמַה שֶׁהוּא צָרִיךְ לְהִתְקָרֵב.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. כִּי בְּאַבְרָהָם כְּתִיב וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחוֹק. וּבְיַעֲקֹב כְּתִיב וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם. כִּי הוּא זָכָה יוֹתֵר, כִּי זָכָה לִפְגֹּעַ מַמָּשׁ בַּמָּקוֹם (וְכַמּוּבָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ), אַךְ אַף עַל פִּי כֵן יָדַע שֶׁעֲדַיִן הַמָּקוֹם רָחוֹק מְאֹד עַד עֵת קֵץ. וְעַל כֵּן וַיָּלֶן שָׁם, שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל

צָרוֹת חֶשְׁכַת הַגָּלוּת, כַּמּוּבָא. כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁשָּׁקְעָה שֶׁלֹּא בְּעוֹנָתָהּ.

וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה שֶׁעוֹבֵר עַל כָּל אֶחָד, שֶׁלִּפְעָמִים בְּחֶמְלַת ה' נִפְתָּח לוֹ אוֹר גָּדוֹל, וְנִדְמֶה לוֹ שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי יִהְיֶה אִישׁ כָּשֵׁר כָּרָאוּי, וְאַחַר כָּךְ פִּתְאֹם נֶחְשָׁךְ לוֹ כְּאִלּוּ בָּא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מַמָּשׁ פִּתְאֹם שֶׁלֹּא בְּעוֹנָתָהּ.

וְאָז הוֹדִיעוּ לוֹ לְיַעֲקֹב בַּחֲלוֹם שֶׁכָּל זֶה הוּא בְּחִינַת וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה, שֶׁזֶּהוּ כָּל עֲבוֹדַת הָאָדָם, שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לֵילֵךְ מִדַּרְגָּא לְדַרְגָּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁעוֹלִין בְּסֻלָּם וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים, שֶׁהֵם הַצַּדִּיקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ שֶׁצָּרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לָהֶם כַּמָּה עֲלִיּוֹת וִירִידוֹת, כִּי קֹדֶם הָעֲלִיָּה צָרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה יְרִידָה וְהַיְרִידָה הוּא תַּכְלִית הָעֲלִיָּה.

עַל כֵּן אַל יִשְׁתּוֹמֵם הָאָדָם וְאַל יִפֹּל בְּדַעְתּוֹ מִכָּל מַה שֶׁעוֹבֵר עָלָיו, עַל כֵּן אַל יִטְעֶה בֵּין בָּעֲלִיָּה בֵּין בִּירִידָה, הַיְנוּ כְּשֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת אֵיזֶה עֲלִיָּה שֶׁרוֹאֶה אֵיזֶה יְשׁוּעָה וְהִתְנוֹצְצוּת, אַל יִטְעֶה שֶׁכְּבָר הָאוֹר שֶׁלּוֹ, רַק יֵדַע שֶׁעֲדַיִן הוּא רָחוֹק מְאֹד וְכַנַּ"ל. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה לֹא יִפֹּל כְּשֶׁרוֹאֶה אַחַר כָּךְ שֶׁנֶּחְשַׁךְ אֶצְלוֹ הָאוֹר שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת יְרִידָה.

כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת אַף עַל פִּי כֵן הָאוֹר שֶׁהֵאִיר לוֹ לֹא נִכְבָּה וְלֹא נִסְתַּלֵּק מִמֶּנּוּ, כִּי אוֹר חַסְדּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ מֵאִיר עָלָיו תָּמִיד רַק שֶׁהַכֹּל הוּא בְּחִינַת מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָהּ וּבִבְחִינַת וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחוֹק, אֲבָל סוֹף כָּל סוֹף יִגְמֹר ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ מַה שֶׁהִתְחִיל וְיֵיטִיב עִם כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעִם כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד בִּפְרָטִיּוּת. רַק שֶׁצְּרִיכִים לִהְיוֹת מְצַפִּים לִישׁוּעָה תָּמִיד בִּבְחִינַת וְכָל עַיִן לְךָ תְּצַפֶּה. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאוֹמְרִים, כִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּינוּ כָּל הַיּוֹם וּמְצַפִּים לִישׁוּעָה.

(הלכות שילוח הקן הלכה ה')
segments.en:
They informed Yaakov in the dream that a person must go through ascents and descents, and he should not think during an ascent that it will always remain so.

"And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set upon the earth," etc.

(28:12)

One must know that sometimes, when Hashem, blessed be He, helps him so that some illumination flashes for him and he sees some drawing-near—even though in truth it is a genuine drawing-near from Him, blessed be He, and a great and wondrous kindness, in which Hashem, blessed be He, wondrously bestows His kindness upon him—nevertheless he must not mistakenly think that he is already close and near to Hashem, blessed be He, and to the Torah and to the righteous people.

For he must know all the above: that however much closer he is, he is still very, very far away, for His greatness is unfathomable; and it is impossible to explain this well, as is explained in the teaching mentioned above. But nevertheless he must know that the deliverance and kindness of every single drawing-near, however little, is a wondrous kindness, for it is a genuine drawing-near, and His deliverance is forever. Yet nevertheless the ultimate fulfillment of his deliverance is still very far from him, and he must still stand and greatly await His deliverance, blessed be He, until he merits to be delivered completely, to leave what he needs to leave and draw near to what he needs to draw near.

And this is the aspect of "And he encountered the place and lodged there, for the sun had set." For concerning Avraham it is written, "And he saw the place from afar," whereas concerning Yaakov it is written, "And he encountered the place." For he attained more, for he merited actually to encounter the place (and as cited in the holy Zohar). But nevertheless he knew that the place is still very far away until the time of the end. And therefore, "And he lodged there," which alludes to

the troubles of the darkness of exile, as is cited. "For the sun had set": it set before its appointed time.

And this is the aspect of what each person undergoes: sometimes, in Hashem's compassion a great light is opened for him, and it seems to him that he will certainly be a properly worthy person; and afterward it suddenly becomes dark for him, as if the sun had actually set suddenly, before its appointed time.

And then they informed Yaakov in the dream that all this is the aspect of "And behold, a ladder was set upon the earth, and its head reached heavenward": this is all of a person's service, that he must go from level to level, as when ascending a ladder. "And behold, angels of Elokim"—who are the righteous people—"were ascending and descending upon it": they must undergo several ascents and descents, for before the ascent there must be a descent, and the descent is for the ultimate purpose of the ascent.

Therefore a person should not be dismayed, nor should he lose heart over everything he undergoes; therefore he should not err, whether in an ascent or in a descent. That is, when he is in the aspect of some ascent, seeing some deliverance and illumination, he should not mistakenly think that the light is already his; rather, he should know that he is still very far away, as above. And through this he will not fall when he afterward sees that the light has become dark for him, which is the aspect of a descent.

For in truth, nevertheless, the light that shone for him has not been extinguished and has not departed from him, for the light of His kindness, blessed be He, shines upon him constantly. It is only that everything is in the aspect of "From afar she brings her bread", and in the aspect of "And he saw the place from afar." But ultimately Hashem, blessed be He, will complete what He began and will do good to the collective of Israel and to each and every individual in particular. Only one must always await deliverance, in the aspect of "And every eye shall await You," and as we say, "For Your deliverance we have hoped all day, and await deliverance."

(Halachos of Shiloo'ach HaKan [Sending Away the Mother Bird], Halacha 5)

That is, when he is in the aspect of some ascent, seeing some deliverance and illumination, he should not mistakenly think that the light is already his; rather, he should know that he is still very far away, as above. And through this he will not fall when he afterward sees that the light has become dark for him, which is the aspect of a descent.

pairs.he: כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת אַף עַל פִּי כֵן הָאוֹר שֶׁהֵאִיר לוֹ לֹא נִכְבָּה וְלֹא נִסְתַּלֵּק מִמֶּנּוּ, כִּי אוֹר חַסְדּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ מֵאִיר עָלָיו תָּמִיד רַק שֶׁהַכֹּל הוּא בְּחִינַת מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָהּ וּבִבְחִינַת וַיַּרְא אֶת הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחוֹק, אֲבָל סוֹף כָּל סוֹף יִגְמֹר ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ מַה שֶׁהִתְחִיל וְיֵיטִיב עִם כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעִם כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד בִּפְרָטִיּוּת. רַק שֶׁצְּרִיכִים לִהְיוֹת מְצַפִּים לִישׁוּעָה תָּמִיד בִּבְחִינַת וְכָל עַיִן לְךָ תְּצַפֶּה. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאוֹמְרִים, כִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ קִוִּינוּ כָּל הַיּוֹם וּמְצַפִּים לִישׁוּעָה.
pairs.en: For in truth, nevertheless, the light that shone for him has not been extinguished and has not departed from him, for the light of His kindness, blessed be He, shines upon him constantly. It is only that everything is in the aspect of "From afar she brings her bread", and in the aspect of "And he saw the place from afar." But ultimately Hashem, blessed be He, will complete what He began and will do good to the collective of Israel and to each and every individual in particular. Only one must always await deliverance, in the aspect of "And every eye shall await You," and as we say, "For Your deliverance we have hoped all day, and await deliverance."

segments.he:
ענין עליות וירידות

"וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה" וגו׳

(כ״ח, י״ב) ויצא יעקב מבאר שבע

׳וַיֵּלֶךְ חָרָנָה׳, הַיְנוּ כְּשֶׁאִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי יוֹצֵא מִדַּרְגָּא לְדַרְגָּא אָז מִשְׁתַּטְּחִים וּמִתְפַּשְּׁטִים כְּנֶגְדּוֹ הַקְּלִפּוֹת שֶׁהֵם הַדִּמְיוֹנוֹת וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת חָרוֹן אַף כִּי הֵם מִתַּקָּפָא דְּדִינָא כַּיָּדוּעַ. וְזֶהוּ וַיֵּצֵא יַעֲקֹב שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי. ׳מִבְּאֵר שָׁבַע׳ הַיְנוּ מֵהַמַּדְרֵגָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה שֶׁהָיָה בָּהּ שֶׁנִּקְרֵאת בְּאֵר שֶׁבַע כִּי כָּל דַּרְגָּא וְדַרְגָּא דִּקְדֻשָּׁה כְּלוּלָה מִכָּל הַשִּׁבְעָה מִדּוֹת שֶׁהֵם ז׳ יְמֵי הַבִּנְיָן שֶׁכְּלוּלִים בְּכָל דַּרְגָּא. וּכְשֶׁיַּעֲקֹב שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי יוֹצֵא מִשָּׁם כְּדֵי לָבוֹא לְמַדְרֵגָה שְׁנִיָּה הַגְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר, אָז וַיֵּלֶךְ חָרָנָה שֶׁמֻּכְרָח לֵילֵךְ דֶּרֶךְ הַחָרוֹן אַף שֶׁהֵם הַקְּלִפּוֹת שֶׁהֵם כָּל הַדִּמְיוֹנוֹת וְהַתַּאֲווֹת וְהַבִּלְבּוּלִים שֶׁמִּתְפַּשְּׁטִים כְּנֶגְדּוֹ בְּכָל פַּעַם.

אֲבָל מֵחֲמַת שֶׁאִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי בְּחִינַת יַעֲקֹב חָזָק בְּדַעְתּוֹ וְאֵינוֹ מַנִּיחַ אֶת מְקוֹמוֹ וְאֵינוֹ נוֹפֵל בְּדַעְתּוֹ, מֵחֲמַת זֶה רַק מִתְחַזֵּק בְּכָל מַה דְּאֶפְשָׁר לַעֲמֹד עַל עָמְדוֹ, עַל יְדֵי זֶה ׳וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם׳ עַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה לְהָבִין הָאֱמֶת, שֶׁמַּה שֶּׁמִּתְפַּשְּׁטִים הַתַּאֲווֹת וְכוּ׳ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ אֵין זֶה נְפִילָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, רַק שֶׁהוּא מֵחֲמַת שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לָבוֹא לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר וּלְהִתְקָרֵב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּהִתְקָרְבוּת יוֹתֵר, מֵחֲמַת זֶה מִתְפַּשְּׁטִים כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ.

צ

וְזֶהוּ ׳וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם׳ שֶׁזָּכָה בְּתֹקֶף הַחָרוֹן אַף שֶׁהֵם הַקְּלִפּוֹת שֶׁנִּתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ, לִפְגֹּעַ שָׁם בִּמְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, כִּי כָּל מַה שֶּׁעוֹלִים לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר מִתְקָרְבִים בְּיוֹתֵר לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁהוּא מְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם שֶׁכָּל הַמְּקוֹמוֹת וְכָל הַדַּרְגוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם כְּלוּלִים בּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ כִּי הוּא יִתְבָּרַךְ מְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם וְאֵין הָעוֹלָם מְקוֹמוֹ. הַיְנוּ שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב בְּחִינַת אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי עַל יְדֵי גֹּדֶל הִתְחַזְּקוּתוֹ זָכָה לְהָבִין הָאֱמֶת שֶׁאֵין זֶה נְפִילָה וְהִתְרַחֲקוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם רַק פָּגַע שָׁם דַּיְקָא בִּמְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, שֶׁהֵבִין שֶׁשָּׁם דַּיְקָא צָרִיךְ לָבוֹא לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר לְהִתְקָרֵב בְּיוֹתֵר לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְעַל כֵּן מִתְפַּשְּׁטִים כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ.

וְאָז ׳וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ׳ הַיְנוּ שֶׁקִּבֵּל עַל עַצְמוֹ וְסָבַל צַעַר הַחֹשֶׁךְ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת לַיְלָה וְלָן שָׁם בְּצַעֲרוֹ שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ מֵרְדִיפַת הַתַּאֲווֹת וְהַדִּמְיוֹנוֹת שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת חָרוֹן אַף שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת הַקְּלִפּוֹת שֶׁנִּתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיָה צָרִיךְ לַעֲלוֹת לְמַדְרֵגָה שְׁנִיָּה.

וְזֶהוּ כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁהוּא הַשֵּׂכֶל וְהַמֹּחִין שֶׁנִּסְתַּלְּקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ. כִּי בְּעֵת הִתְגַּבְּרוּתָם וְהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּתָם אֵין הַשֵּׂכֶל בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, כִּי כֹּחַ הַמְדַמֶּה שֶׁמִּשָּׁם כָּל הַתַּאֲווֹת הוּא כְּנֶגֶד הַשֵּׂכֶל. וְזֶהוּ ׳כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ׳ שֶׁלֹּא בְּעוֹנָתָהּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁדָּרְשׁוּ רז״ל, הַיְנוּ שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי בִּיאַת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁהוּא הִסְתַּלְּקוּת הַמֹּחִין שֶׁהָיוּ לוֹ אָז הָיָה שֶׁלֹּא בְּעוֹנָתָהּ שֶׁלֹּא בִּזְמַנּוֹ, לֹא הָיָה בְּדִין שֶׁיִּסְתַּלֵּק שִׂכְלוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְיִתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ, כִּי לֹא הָיָה מֵחֲמַת נְפִילָתוֹ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, רַק מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיָה צָרִיךְ לַעֲלוֹת לְמַדְרֵגָה שְׁנִיָּה.

׳וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא׳ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי שֶׁעָמַד אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי עַל עָמְדוֹ וְלֹא הִנִּיחַ עַצְמוֹ לִפּוֹל עַל יְדֵי תֹּקֶף הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת שֶׁנִּתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ וְזָכָה לְהַמְשִׁיךְ הִתְגַּלּוּת הַגְּוָנִין עַד שֶׁהִכְנִיעַ וְשִׁבֵּר אוֹתָם עַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה לַעֲלוֹת אֶל הַשֵּׂכֶל שֶׁבַּמַּדְרֵגָה הַגְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר.

וְאָז ׳וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה׳ הַיְנוּ שֶׁאָז הֶרְאוּ לוֹ שֶׁכָּל עֲבוֹדַת הָאָדָם בָּזֶה הָעוֹלָם הוּא בִּבְחִינָה זֹאת בְּחִינַת סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה, הַיְנוּ שֶׁהוּא צָרִיךְ בְּכָל פַּעַם לַעֲלוֹת מִדַּרְגָּא לְדַרְגָּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁעוֹלִין בַּסֻּלָּם. וּמֵחֲמַת זֶה מִתְגַּבְּרִין וּמִשְׁתַּטְּחִין וּמִתְפַּשְּׁטִין כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ בְּכָל פַּעַם. וְזֶהוּ ׳וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ׳, מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים הֵם הָעוֹבְדֵי ה׳ שֶׁנִּמְשְׁלוּ לְמַלְאָכִים עוֹלִים וְיוֹרְדִים בּוֹ בְּזֶה הַסֻּלָּם, כִּי כָּל עֲלִיָּתָם וִירִידָתָם הוּא בִּבְחִינַת הַסֻּלָּם הַזֶּה. שֶׁמִּי שֶׁהוּא פִּקֵּחַ וּמַאֲמִין לְדִבְרֵי הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁאֵין זֶה נְפִילָה כְּלָל וּמִתְחַזֵּק וּמִתְגַּבֵּר כַּנַּ״ל, הוּא עוֹלֶה עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר. וּלְהֶפֶךְ מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִתְחַזֵּק הוּא יוֹרֵד חַס וְשָׁלוֹם עַל יְדֵי זֶה.

צא

וְזֶהוּ ׳וְהִנֵּה ה׳ נִצָּב עָלָיו וַיֹּאמַר׳ וְכוּ׳, שֶׁהִבְטִיחוֹ בְּכַמָּה הַבְטָחוֹת כִּי מֵחֲמַת שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי הַכָּשֵׁר עָמַד בַּנִּסָּיוֹן וְלֹא הֵנִיחַ אֶת מְקוֹמוֹ עַד שֶׁעָלָה לְמַדְרֵגָה שְׁנִיָּה כַּנַּ״ל, עַל כֵּן הִבְטִיחוֹ ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה עִמּוֹ וְכוּ׳ וּשְׁמַרְתִּיךָ בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ וְכוּ׳, שֶׁהִבְטִיחוֹ שֶׁאע״פ שֶׁיַּעֲבֹר עָלָיו עוֹד כָּהֵנָּה וְכָהֵנָּה אֲבָל ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ יִשְׁמְרֵהוּ בְּכָל עֵת בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר יֵלֵךְ עַד אֲשֶׁר יְבִיאֵהוּ לְמַדְרֵגָתוֹ הָעֶלְיוֹנָה בִּשְׁלֵמוּת. בְּחִינַת ׳כִּי לֹא אֶעֱזָבְךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם עָשִׂיתִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ׳, בִּשְׁבִילְךָ, דְהַיְנוּ מַה שֶּׁדִּבֵּר עִם הַצַּדִּיקֵי אֱמֶת אֶת כָּל הַמַּדְרֵגוֹת הַקְּדוֹשׁוֹת שֶׁיְּזַכֵּנוּ בְּרַחֲמָיו הַמְרֻבִּים.

וְזֶהוּ ׳וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ ה׳ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׳ הַיְנוּ כְּשֶׁהֵקִיץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וְצַעֲרוֹ שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ בְּעֵת שֶׁהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ, אָז אָמַר ׳אָכֵן יֵשׁ ה׳ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׳ כִּי נִדְמֶה לִי כְּאִלּוּ אֵין שָׁם ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי הַדִּמְיוֹנוֹת רָצוּ לְבַלְבֵּל אוֹתִי כְּאִלּוּ אֵין שָׁם ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְרָצוּ לְהַפִּיל אוֹתִי חַס וְשָׁלוֹם. וּמַה גָּדְלוּ חַסְדֵי ה׳ אֲשֶׁר עֲזָרוּנִי עַד פֹּה לַעֲמֹד עַל עָמְדִי עַד שֶׁנּוֹדַע לִי כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת יֵשׁ ה׳ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה. כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת לֹא הָיָה נְפִילָה כְּלָל רַק שֶׁהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדִּי מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיִיתִי צָרִיךְ לַעֲלוֹת לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר וּלְהִתְקָרֵב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּהִתְקָרְבוּת יוֹתֵר כַּנַּ״ל.

צב

(הלכות מתנה הלכה ד׳ אות י״ב)
segments.en:
The matter of ascents and descents

“And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set upon the earth,” etc.

(28:12) And Yaakov went out from Beer Sheva

“He went toward Charan”—that is, when a Jewish person goes from level to level, the klipos, which are the imaginings, etc., then flatten themselves and spread out against him. They are an aspect of burning anger, for they come from the force of judgment, as is known. And this is “And Yaakov went out”: he is the Jewish person. “From Beer Sheva” means from the holy level at which he had been, which is called Beer Sheva, for each and every holy level includes all seven attributes, which are the seven days of construction included in every level. And when Yaakov, who is the Jewish person, goes out from there in order to come to a second, higher level, then “he went toward Charan”: he must pass through the burning anger, which is the klipos—all the imaginings, desires, and confusions that spread out against him each time.

But because the Jewish person, the aspect of Yaakov, is firm in his resolve, does not leave his place, and does not become discouraged on account of this, but only strengthens himself in every possible way to stand his ground, through this “he encountered the Place.” Through this he merited to understand the truth: that the fact that the desires, etc., spread out against him so greatly is not a fall, God forbid, but only occurs because he needs to come to a higher level and draw closer to God, blessed be He, with a greater closeness. For this reason they spread out against him so greatly.

90

And this is “He encountered the Place”: amid the force of the burning anger, which is the klipos that spread out against him, he merited to encounter there the Place of the world. For the more one ascends to a higher level, the closer one draws to God, blessed be He, who is the Place of the world, in whom all the places and all the levels in the world are included. For He, blessed be He, is the Place of the world, and the world is not His place. That is, Yaakov, the aspect of the Jewish person, through his great strengthening, merited to understand the truth: this is not a fall and a distancing, God forbid; rather, precisely there he encountered the Place of the world. He understood that precisely there he needs to come to a higher level to draw closer to God, blessed be He, and therefore they spread out against him so greatly.

And then, “And he lodged there, for the sun had set”: that is, he accepted upon himself and endured the pain of the darkness, which is the aspect of night. And he lodged there in his pain, which he experienced from the pursuit of the desires and imaginings—the aspect of burning anger, the aspect of the klipos that spread out against him because he needed to ascend to a second level.

And this is “for the sun had set”: it is the intellect and the mochin that had departed from him. For at the time of their intensification and spreading, the intellect is not complete, because the imaginative faculty, from where all the desires come, opposes the intellect. And this is “for the sun had set” before its appointed time, as our Sages of blessed memory expounded. That is, certainly the setting of the sun—the departure of the mochin that he experienced then—was before its appointed time, not at its proper time. It was not warranted that his intellect depart from him and that they spread out against him so greatly, for it was not because of his fall, God forbid, but only because he needed to ascend to a second level.

“And he lay down in that place”: because the Jewish person stood his ground and did not allow himself to fall through the force of the spreading that spread out against him, and merited to draw forth the revelation of the colors until he subdued and broke them, through this he merited to ascend to the intellect at the higher level.

And then, “And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set upon the earth, and its top reached heaven.” That is, then they showed him that all a person's service in this world is in this aspect—the aspect of a ladder set upon the earth with its top reaching heaven. That is, each time he needs to ascend from level to level, as one climbs a ladder. And because of this, they grow strong and flatten themselves, and spread out against him so greatly each time. And this is “And behold, angels of God were ascending and descending on it.” The angels of God are those who serve God, who are likened to angels; they ascend and descend on it, on this ladder, for all their ascent and descent is in the aspect of this ladder. For whoever is discerning and believes the tzaddik’s words that this is not a fall at all, and strengthens himself and overcomes as above, ascends through this to a higher level. And conversely, whoever does not strengthen himself descends through this, God forbid.

91

And this is “And behold, God stood over him and said,” etc.: He promised him several promises. For because Yaakov, who is the worthy Jewish person, withstood the trial and did not leave his place until he ascended to a second level, as above, therefore God, blessed be He, promised him that He would be with him, etc., “And I will guard you wherever you go,” etc. He promised him that, although he would undergo still more such things, God, blessed be He, would nevertheless guard him at every time, wherever he goes, until He brings him to his highest level in completeness. This is the aspect of “For I will not leave you until I have done that which I spoke to you”—for you: that is, what He spoke with the true tzaddikim concerning all the holy levels that He would enable us to attain through His abundant compassion.

And this is “And Yaakov awoke from his sleep and said: Indeed, God is in this place, and I did not know.” That is, when he awoke from his sleep and from the distress he had experienced when they spread out against him so greatly, he then said, “Indeed, God is in this place, and I did not know.” For it seemed to me as though God, blessed be He, was not there, because the imaginings sought to confuse me, as though God, blessed be He, was not there, and sought to cast me down, God forbid. And how great are God’s kindnesses, which have helped me thus far to stand my ground, until it became known to me that in truth God is in this place. For in truth it was not a fall at all; rather, they spread out against me because I needed to ascend to a higher level and draw closer to God, blessed be He, with a greater closeness, as above.

92

(Halachos of Gifts, Halacha 4, item 12)

For this reason they spread out against him so greatly.

pairs.he: צ

וְזֶהוּ ׳וַיִּפְגַּע בַּמָּקוֹם׳ שֶׁזָּכָה בְּתֹקֶף הַחָרוֹן אַף שֶׁהֵם הַקְּלִפּוֹת שֶׁנִּתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ, לִפְגֹּעַ שָׁם בִּמְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, כִּי כָּל מַה שֶּׁעוֹלִים לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר מִתְקָרְבִים בְּיוֹתֵר לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁהוּא מְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם שֶׁכָּל הַמְּקוֹמוֹת וְכָל הַדַּרְגוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם כְּלוּלִים בּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ כִּי הוּא יִתְבָּרַךְ מְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם וְאֵין הָעוֹלָם מְקוֹמוֹ. הַיְנוּ שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב בְּחִינַת אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי עַל יְדֵי גֹּדֶל הִתְחַזְּקוּתוֹ זָכָה לְהָבִין הָאֱמֶת שֶׁאֵין זֶה נְפִילָה וְהִתְרַחֲקוּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם רַק פָּגַע שָׁם דַּיְקָא בִּמְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, שֶׁהֵבִין שֶׁשָּׁם דַּיְקָא צָרִיךְ לָבוֹא לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר לְהִתְקָרֵב בְּיוֹתֵר לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְעַל כֵּן מִתְפַּשְּׁטִים כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ.
pairs.en: And this is “He encountered the Place”: amid the force of the burning anger, which is the klipos that spread out against him, he merited to encounter there the Place of the world. For the more one ascends to a higher level, the closer one draws to God, blessed be He, who is the Place of the world, in whom all the places and all the levels in the world are included. For He, blessed be He, is the Place of the world, and the world is not His place. That is, Yaakov, the aspect of the Jewish person, through his great strengthening, merited to understand the truth: this is not a fall and a distancing, God forbid; rather, precisely there he encountered the Place of the world. He understood that precisely there he needs to come to a higher level to draw closer to God, blessed be He, and therefore they spread out against him so greatly.

pairs.he: וְאָז ׳וַיָּלֶן שָׁם כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ׳ הַיְנוּ שֶׁקִּבֵּל עַל עַצְמוֹ וְסָבַל צַעַר הַחֹשֶׁךְ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת לַיְלָה וְלָן שָׁם בְּצַעֲרוֹ שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ מֵרְדִיפַת הַתַּאֲווֹת וְהַדִּמְיוֹנוֹת שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת חָרוֹן אַף שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת הַקְּלִפּוֹת שֶׁנִּתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיָה צָרִיךְ לַעֲלוֹת לְמַדְרֵגָה שְׁנִיָּה.
pairs.en: And then, “And he lodged there, for the sun had set”: that is, he accepted upon himself and endured the pain of the darkness, which is the aspect of night. And he lodged there in his pain, which he experienced from the pursuit of the desires and imaginings—the aspect of burning anger, the aspect of the klipos that spread out against him because he needed to ascend to a second level.

pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁהוּא הַשֵּׂכֶל וְהַמֹּחִין שֶׁנִּסְתַּלְּקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ. כִּי בְּעֵת הִתְגַּבְּרוּתָם וְהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּתָם אֵין הַשֵּׂכֶל בִּשְׁלֵמוּת, כִּי כֹּחַ הַמְדַמֶּה שֶׁמִּשָּׁם כָּל הַתַּאֲווֹת הוּא כְּנֶגֶד הַשֵּׂכֶל. וְזֶהוּ ׳כִּי בָא הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ׳ שֶׁלֹּא בְּעוֹנָתָהּ כְּמוֹ שֶׁדָּרְשׁוּ רז״ל, הַיְנוּ שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי בִּיאַת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שֶׁהוּא הִסְתַּלְּקוּת הַמֹּחִין שֶׁהָיוּ לוֹ אָז הָיָה שֶׁלֹּא בְּעוֹנָתָהּ שֶׁלֹּא בִּזְמַנּוֹ, לֹא הָיָה בְּדִין שֶׁיִּסְתַּלֵּק שִׂכְלוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ וְיִתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ, כִּי לֹא הָיָה מֵחֲמַת נְפִילָתוֹ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, רַק מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיָה צָרִיךְ לַעֲלוֹת לְמַדְרֵגָה שְׁנִיָּה.
pairs.en: And this is “for the sun had set”: it is the intellect and the mochin that had departed from him. For at the time of their intensification and spreading, the intellect is not complete, because the imaginative faculty, from where all the desires come, opposes the intellect. And this is “for the sun had set” before its appointed time, as our Sages of blessed memory expounded. That is, certainly the setting of the sun—the departure of the mochin that he experienced then—was before its appointed time, not at its proper time. It was not warranted that his intellect depart from him and that they spread out against him so greatly, for it was not because of his fall, God forbid, but only because he needed to ascend to a second level.

pairs.he: ׳וַיִּשְׁכַּב בַּמָּקוֹם הַהוּא׳ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי שֶׁעָמַד אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי עַל עָמְדוֹ וְלֹא הִנִּיחַ עַצְמוֹ לִפּוֹל עַל יְדֵי תֹּקֶף הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת שֶׁנִּתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ וְזָכָה לְהַמְשִׁיךְ הִתְגַּלּוּת הַגְּוָנִין עַד שֶׁהִכְנִיעַ וְשִׁבֵּר אוֹתָם עַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה לַעֲלוֹת אֶל הַשֵּׂכֶל שֶׁבַּמַּדְרֵגָה הַגְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר.
pairs.en: “And he lay down in that place”: because the Jewish person stood his ground and did not allow himself to fall through the force of the spreading that spread out against him, and merited to draw forth the revelation of the colors until he subdued and broke them, through this he merited to ascend to the intellect at the higher level.

pairs.he: וְאָז ׳וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה׳ הַיְנוּ שֶׁאָז הֶרְאוּ לוֹ שֶׁכָּל עֲבוֹדַת הָאָדָם בָּזֶה הָעוֹלָם הוּא בִּבְחִינָה זֹאת בְּחִינַת סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה, הַיְנוּ שֶׁהוּא צָרִיךְ בְּכָל פַּעַם לַעֲלוֹת מִדַּרְגָּא לְדַרְגָּא כְּמוֹ שֶׁעוֹלִין בַּסֻּלָּם. וּמֵחֲמַת זֶה מִתְגַּבְּרִין וּמִשְׁתַּטְּחִין וּמִתְפַּשְּׁטִין כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ בְּכָל פַּעַם. וְזֶהוּ ׳וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ׳, מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים הֵם הָעוֹבְדֵי ה׳ שֶׁנִּמְשְׁלוּ לְמַלְאָכִים עוֹלִים וְיוֹרְדִים בּוֹ בְּזֶה הַסֻּלָּם, כִּי כָּל עֲלִיָּתָם וִירִידָתָם הוּא בִּבְחִינַת הַסֻּלָּם הַזֶּה. שֶׁמִּי שֶׁהוּא פִּקֵּחַ וּמַאֲמִין לְדִבְרֵי הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁאֵין זֶה נְפִילָה כְּלָל וּמִתְחַזֵּק וּמִתְגַּבֵּר כַּנַּ״ל, הוּא עוֹלֶה עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר. וּלְהֶפֶךְ מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִתְחַזֵּק הוּא יוֹרֵד חַס וְשָׁלוֹם עַל יְדֵי זֶה.
pairs.en: And then, “And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set upon the earth, and its top reached heaven.” That is, then they showed him that all a person's service in this world is in this aspect—the aspect of a ladder set upon the earth with its top reaching heaven. That is, each time he needs to ascend from level to level, as one climbs a ladder. And because of this, they grow strong and flatten themselves, and spread out against him so greatly each time. And this is “And behold, angels of God were ascending and descending on it.” The angels of God are those who serve God, who are likened to angels; they ascend and descend on it, on this ladder, for all their ascent and descent is in the aspect of this ladder. For whoever is discerning and believes the tzaddik’s words that this is not a fall at all, and strengthens himself and overcomes as above, ascends through this to a higher level. And conversely, whoever does not strengthen himself descends through this, God forbid.

pairs.he: צא

וְזֶהוּ ׳וְהִנֵּה ה׳ נִצָּב עָלָיו וַיֹּאמַר׳ וְכוּ׳, שֶׁהִבְטִיחוֹ בְּכַמָּה הַבְטָחוֹת כִּי מֵחֲמַת שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב שֶׁהוּא אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי הַכָּשֵׁר עָמַד בַּנִּסָּיוֹן וְלֹא הֵנִיחַ אֶת מְקוֹמוֹ עַד שֶׁעָלָה לְמַדְרֵגָה שְׁנִיָּה כַּנַּ״ל, עַל כֵּן הִבְטִיחוֹ ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה עִמּוֹ וְכוּ׳ וּשְׁמַרְתִּיךָ בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ וְכוּ׳, שֶׁהִבְטִיחוֹ שֶׁאע״פ שֶׁיַּעֲבֹר עָלָיו עוֹד כָּהֵנָּה וְכָהֵנָּה אֲבָל ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ יִשְׁמְרֵהוּ בְּכָל עֵת בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר יֵלֵךְ עַד אֲשֶׁר יְבִיאֵהוּ לְמַדְרֵגָתוֹ הָעֶלְיוֹנָה בִּשְׁלֵמוּת. בְּחִינַת ׳כִּי לֹא אֶעֱזָבְךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם עָשִׂיתִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ׳, בִּשְׁבִילְךָ, דְהַיְנוּ מַה שֶּׁדִּבֵּר עִם הַצַּדִּיקֵי אֱמֶת אֶת כָּל הַמַּדְרֵגוֹת הַקְּדוֹשׁוֹת שֶׁיְּזַכֵּנוּ בְּרַחֲמָיו הַמְרֻבִּים.
pairs.en: And this is “And behold, God stood over him and said,” etc.: He promised him several promises. For because Yaakov, who is the worthy Jewish person, withstood the trial and did not leave his place until he ascended to a second level, as above, therefore God, blessed be He, promised him that He would be with him, etc., “And I will guard you wherever you go,” etc. He promised him that, although he would undergo still more such things, God, blessed be He, would nevertheless guard him at every time, wherever he goes, until He brings him to his highest level in completeness. This is the aspect of “For I will not leave you until I have done that which I spoke to you”—for you: that is, what He spoke with the true tzaddikim concerning all the holy levels that He would enable us to attain through His abundant compassion.

pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ ׳וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ ה׳ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׳ הַיְנוּ כְּשֶׁהֵקִיץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וְצַעֲרוֹ שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ בְּעֵת שֶׁהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדּוֹ כָּל כָּךְ, אָז אָמַר ׳אָכֵן יֵשׁ ה׳ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׳ כִּי נִדְמֶה לִי כְּאִלּוּ אֵין שָׁם ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי הַדִּמְיוֹנוֹת רָצוּ לְבַלְבֵּל אוֹתִי כְּאִלּוּ אֵין שָׁם ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְרָצוּ לְהַפִּיל אוֹתִי חַס וְשָׁלוֹם. וּמַה גָּדְלוּ חַסְדֵי ה׳ אֲשֶׁר עֲזָרוּנִי עַד פֹּה לַעֲמֹד עַל עָמְדִי עַד שֶׁנּוֹדַע לִי כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת יֵשׁ ה׳ בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה. כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת לֹא הָיָה נְפִילָה כְּלָל רַק שֶׁהִתְפַּשְּׁטוּ כְּנֶגְדִּי מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיִיתִי צָרִיךְ לַעֲלוֹת לְמַדְרֵגָה גְּבוֹהַ יוֹתֵר וּלְהִתְקָרֵב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּהִתְקָרְבוּת יוֹתֵר כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: And this is “And Yaakov awoke from his sleep and said: Indeed, God is in this place, and I did not know.” That is, when he awoke from his sleep and from the distress he had experienced when they spread out against him so greatly, he then said, “Indeed, God is in this place, and I did not know.” For it seemed to me as though God, blessed be He, was not there, because the imaginings sought to confuse me, as though God, blessed be He, was not there, and sought to cast me down, God forbid. And how great are God’s kindnesses, which have helped me thus far to stand my ground, until it became known to me that in truth God is in this place. For in truth it was not a fall at all; rather, they spread out against me because I needed to ascend to a higher level and draw closer to God, blessed be He, with a greater closeness, as above.

pairs.he: צב
(הלכות מתנה הלכה ד׳ אות י״ב)
pairs.en: (Halachos of Gifts, Halacha 4, item 12)

88.

segments.he:
פט. בחיי מוהר"ן (סימן ש"ל): אמר אני יכול לעשות מכלכם צדיקים גמורים נוראים, אבל מה יהיה אם כן יעבוד השם יתברך בעצמו את עצמו (כלומר שרצונו הוא שאנחנו בעצמנו נתיגע בכחו ועצותיו הקדושים להשיג עבודת השם. אבל לא שהוא יתן הכל לגמרי). וכן שמעתי עוד בכמה לשונות שאמר, אני יכול לתן יראה להאדם עד שיצא מחייו ויתבטל במציאות. ופעם אחת בקש מאתו אחד מאנשי שלומנו הרבה בענין זה שיתן לו יראה. (וכמדומה לי הכותב שזה היה ר' שמעון המשמש שלו (מכת"י)) ודבר עמו רבנו זכרונו לברכה דברים כעין הנ"ל שבודאי יכול לתן [לו] יראה עצומה רק שאין זה תכלית, כי אם כן יתבטל במציאות. והאיש הנ"ל היה משתוקק אף על פי כן שיאיר עליו יראה עצומה, ואחר כך יצא האיש מלפניו ונפל עליו יראה עצומה ומפלגת מאד, והתחיל לצעק להשם יתברך בקולות משנות מה שלא

היה רגיל בכך עד שכמעט יצא מחיותו. ונמשך כך עד למחרתו. ולמחרת נכנס אצלו ושאל אותו רבנו זכרונו לברכה אם הגיע אליו יראה, השיב לו האיש הנ"ל שוב איני רוצה בזה, ובקש מאתו שיקח ממנו זאת וחזר ולקח ממנו ושב לקדמותו. וכן אמר לאחד אם הייתי מעביר ידי על עיניך היית רואה גדולות ונפלאות, אבל איני רוצה בזה, רק שאתה בעצמך תתיגע בעבודת השם עד שתזכה למה שתזכה. וכן אמר לי פעם אחת בענין זה אם היה השם יתברך בעצמו רוצה, שהוא יתברך בעצמו יעבד את עצמו, אם כן לא היה צריך אותך. (כלומר שהצדיק יכול להמשיך רצון השם יתברך שיעוררהו בעבודתו אף על פי שיעשה מה שיעשה וראוי לרחקו אף על פי כן יכול הצדיק לעורר רחמי השם יתברך עליו שיקרבהו לעבודתו אבל לא שהשם יתברך יעשה הכל בעצמו). ע"כ. ובליקוטי הלכות (דברים הנוהגים בסעודה הלכה ד' אות י"ד):

ובודאי יש כח ביד הצדיק לטול הבחירה מהאדם ולהחזירו בתשובה, אבל אין זה תיקון מאחר שאינו עושה תשובה בבחירתו. ע"כ. ועי' בספר בן לאשרי להרה"ק רבי יצחק הכהן זצ"ל (סוף חלק ג' בקונטרס "מקבילות הלולאות" אות

א') שכתב בשם האור החיים הק' "משה רבינו ע"ה שהיה רבו הפרטי של יהושע, להכלל ישראל היה רב כללי, ועל כן היה כחו של משה רבינו ע"ה לטול מן יהושע את הבחירה שלא יהיה בעצת מרגלים" ע"כ.
segments.en:
89. In Chayay Moharan (item 330): He said, I can make all of you into awesome, consummate righteous people, but what would happen? In that case Hashem, blessed be He, would serve Himself. (That is, [Rabbainu's] will is that we ourselves exert ourselves through his strength and his holy counsels to attain the service of Hashem, but not that he give everything entirely.) And I also heard in several expressions that he said, I can give a person fear to the point that he departs from his life and is nullified in existence. And once, one of our fellowship begged him greatly concerning this, that he give him fear. (And it seems to me, the writer, that this was Rabbi Shimon, his attendant (from a manuscript).) And Rabbainu, of blessed memory, spoke with him in terms such as those above: that he certainly could give [him] tremendous fear, but that this is not the ultimate purpose, for if so he would be nullified in existence. And that man nevertheless longed for tremendous fear to shine upon him. And afterward the man went out from before him, and tremendous, exceedingly extraordinary fear fell upon him. And he began to cry out to Hashem, blessed be He, in strange cries such as he had never

been accustomed to, until he almost departed from his vitality. And this continued until the following day. And on the following day he entered his presence, and Rabbainu, of blessed memory, asked him whether fear had reached him. That man answered him, I no longer want this, and begged him to take this away from him. And he again took it away from him, and he returned to his former state. And he also said to one: If I were to pass my hand over your eyes, you would see great and wondrous things, but I do not want this; rather, you yourself should exert yourself in the service of Hashem until you attain what you attain. And he also once said to me concerning this: If Hashem, blessed be He, Himself wanted Himself to serve Himself, then He would not need you. (That is, the righteous person can draw forth the will of Hashem, blessed be He, that He awaken him in His service—even though he does what he does and deserves to be distanced, nevertheless the righteous person can arouse Hashem's mercy upon him, that He draw him near to His service; but not that Hashem do everything Himself.) End of quotation. And in Likutay Halachos (Dvurim HaNoahagim BaS'ooduh [Practices at a Meal], Halacha 4, item 14):

And certainly the righteous person has the power to take away a person's free choice and bring him back in repentance, but this is not a rectification, since he does not repent by his own choice. End of quotation. And see the book Ben L'Ashray, by the holy Rabbi Yitzchak HaKoahain, of blessed righteous memory (at the end of Part 3, in the booklet "מקבילות הלולאות" [Parallel Loops], item

1), who wrote in the name of the holy Oar HaChayim: "Moshe Rabbainu, peace be upon him, who was Yehoshua's personal teacher, was a general teacher for the collective of Israel. And therefore Moshe Rabbainu, peace be upon him, had the power to take away Yehoshua's free choice, so that he would not participate in the counsel of the spies." End of quotation.

descriptor.text: In this parenthesis, [Rabbainu's] is an editorial identification of the unnamed Hebrew referent. This edition takes the intention, strength, holy counsels and the final giver to refer to Rabbainu, the reported teacher, on contextual grounds. The Hebrew does not name these antecedents: a reading with Divine will and the teacher's strength and counsels, or the earlier all-Divine reading, is not excluded. This qualified choice does not establish a unique intended agency. The printed item 333 and [him] are retained.

צא. הבאר מים חיים בפרשת לך לך (ויעל אברם ממצרים) כתב: כאשר הצדיק לפעמים נופל ממדריגתו, ירידה זו צורך עליה הוא, ואחר זה הוא עולה למעלה למעלה יותר מבאשר היה מקודם. והוא דמיון אחד הרוצה לזרוק דבר למעלה אז משפיל עצמו ומשפיל ידו למטה לזרוק אחר כך בכח גדול את הדבר למעלה. וכן אדם השלם כשבא לפעמים לבחינת אחור ונופל ממדריגתו אז הוא בא על ידי זה לבחינת קדם קדמתה לעלות מעלה מעלה. וכזה אומרין בשם הבעש״ט זי״ע ועל כל ישראל, במה שאמרו ז״ל (בבא מציעא נ״ט.) אוקירו לנשייכו כי היכי דתתעתרו, כלומר שיהיה יקר וחשוב בעיניכם השכחה והנפילה ממדרגתכם קצת כי היכי דתתעתרו על ידי זה לבוא למעלה נפלאה. ע״כ.

והדגל מחנה אפרים (תחילת הפרשה כאן) כתב: יש בכאן סוד גדלות וקטנות, כידוע בשם אא״ז נ״ע זללה״ה כי החיות רצוא ושוב, ואי אפשר לעמוד על מדרגה אחת תמיד, רק עולה ויורד, והירידה הוא צורך עליה, כשנותן על לב ויודע ומרגיש זה שהוא בקטנות ומתפלל אל ה׳. ע״כ.

ובנוצר חסד (פרק ד׳ אות כב) כתב: כמו למשל בן המלך שנתחבר עם הזונות ואנשי כפר ושחק ורקד עמהם בריקודים ומחולות, ושלח אליו המלך שרים נכבדים ועשה מהם חוכא ואיטלולא כי אמר להם שזהו תכלית הטוב. עד ששר אחד שינה את עצמו כאילו הוא כפרי ושחק ורקד עמו, ומעט מעט על ידי התחברות משך לבו לאביו המלך עד שפעל שהחזירו לאביו. ע״כ.

וכן כתב הלשם שבו ואחלמה (ספר הדע״ה חלק ראשון דף מ״א ע״ב): נמצא שכל ירידה אשר ירד העליון הוא רק לצורך תיקון וכדי שיוצא ויתהוה עי״ז התחתון ג״כ. וזהו ג״כ סוד כל הירידות והקטנות אשר עוברים בכל עת על כל אדם (וכן הוא בהעלם בכל הנמצאות כולם), כי הנה הוא כדי לירד ולהתקרב אל את אשר למטה הימנו וכדי להעלותו. כי נעשה בזה עליית הניצו״ק מבליעתן להוציא יקר מזולל. ע״כ.
segments.en:
91. The Bair Mayim Chayim, in the portion Lech Lechuh (“And Avram went up from Egypt”), wrote: When the tzaddik sometimes falls from his level, this descent is for the sake of ascent; and after this he ascends higher and higher, beyond where he had been before. And it is like someone who wishes to throw an object upward: he first lowers himself and lowers his hand downward, in order afterward to throw the object upward with great force. And likewise, when a perfected person sometimes comes to the aspect of the back and falls from his level, through this he comes to the aspect of the primordial front, to ascend higher and higher. And something like this is said in the name of the Baal Shem Tov, may his merit protect us and all Israel, concerning what the Sages of blessed memory said (Bava Metzia 59a), “Honor your wives so that you may become wealthy.” That is, let forgetfulness and falling somewhat from your level be precious and important in your eyes, “so that you may become wealthy”—through this, to come to a wondrous level. End of quotation.

And the Degel Machanay Efrayim (at the beginning of this portion here) wrote: Here is the mystery of expanded and constricted states, as is known in the name of my revered grandfather, whose soul is in Eden, may his memory be blessed for the life of the World to Come: “For the living beings run and return.” And one cannot remain at a single level always, but rather ascends and descends. And the descent is for the sake of ascent, when one takes it to heart, knows and feels that one is in a constricted state, and prays to God. End of quotation.

And in Noatzair Chesed (chapter 4, item 22) he wrote: For example, it is like a king’s son who associated with prostitutes and villagers and played and danced with them in dances and round dances. And the king sent distinguished ministers to him, and he made a mockery and laughingstock of them, for he told them that this was the ultimate good, until one minister changed himself as though he were a villager and played and danced with him. And little by little, through their association, he drew his heart toward his father the king, until he succeeded in returning him to his father. End of quotation.

And likewise the Leshem Shevo ViAchlamuh wrote (Sefer HaDe’uh, first part, folio 41b): It follows that every descent that the higher one descends is only for the sake of repair, and so that through it the lower one will also emerge and come into being. And this is also the mystery of all the descents and constricted states that every person undergoes at every time (and this also occurs, in concealment, in all existing things), for behold, it is in order to descend and draw near to that which is below him, and in order to raise it. For through this the holy sparks are raised out of their being swallowed up, to bring forth the precious from the vile. End of quotation.
